title: Hangover-Cure Crumbled Turkish Redcurrant Crumble
description: A light and tangy dish featuring fresh redcurrants that can help alleviate the symptoms of a hangover in a healthy and refreshing way.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup granulated sugar
ingredients.notes: Opt for a natural sweetener if preferred

ingredients.name: 1/4 cup all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: For a gluten-free version, use gluten-free flour or oat flour instead

instructions: Wash and roughly chop the redcurrants. Place them in a bowl.
In another bowl, mix together the sugar, melted butter, cinnamon, and flour until well combined.
Stir the mixture into the chopped redcurrants. Toss gently to ensure even distribution of ingredients.
Transfer the crumble mixture onto a lightly greased baking dish or cast iron skillet. Press it down evenly with your hands.
Bake in the preheated oven for about 20 minutes, or until golden brown and crispy on top.
Remove from heat once done. Allow to cool slightly before serving as an accompaniment to toast, yogurt, or a glass of cold water.
